name: Huymaier Console FSE Shell, Storefront & Artwork Integration
features: keeps Quick Access exclusive to Huymaier Console while adding a separate external-game/app Huymaier Game Bar
separates physical Guide/Xbox/PS/Home from Xbox View/Back and PlayStation Share/Create
adds a native Microsoft GameInput system-button bridge with Raw HID/XInput compatibility fallback
adds a native Huymaier task switcher for user-facing top-level Windows application windows
adds a centered DPI-aware Huymaier Game Bar with user-adjustable scale
uses horizontal Left/Right controller navigation for Game Bar Home and Switch Apps rails
fixes centered finite-choice popup controller navigation, audio feedback, and visible selected-state feedback
preserves maximized/fullscreen external application state when task switching
removes decorative X/Square Search prompts when no secondary action exists
preserves the v0.25.8 Windows PowerShell BOM packaging and updater ContentLength hotfixes
description: Stable v0.26.0 release with the native Huymaier Game Bar, task switcher, physical Guide routing, controller-friendly finite-choice popups, DPI-aware scaling, and fullscreen-state preservation.
